policy: One selected canonical module per path. Four-universe residue proof is general; old APIs are wrappers. No push or branch deletion by integrator. Existing main files retained, except additive root/test/catalog/document integration.

compiled_declaration_inventory.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : CategoryTheory.HasExt (ModuleCat R)] {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → R)
  (hf : Koszul.IsKoszulRegular f) (g : Fin n → R) (hg : Koszul.IsKoszulRegular g)
  (q : ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range g)) ⟶ ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f)))
  (Φ : (Koszul.seqProjectiveResolution g hg).Hom (Koszul.seqProjectiveResolution f hf) q) (d : R),
  CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (Φ.hom.f n) (Koszul.topEquiv R n).toModuleIso.hom =
      CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (Koszul.topEquiv R n).toModuleIso.hom
        (ModuleCat.ofHom ((LinearMap.lsmul R R) d)) →
    ∀ (N : ModuleCat R) (x : ↑N),
      (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ q).comp ((Koszul.seqTopExtClass f hf N) x) ⋯ =
        (Koszul.seqTopExtClass g hg N) (d • x)
